gr_list.description: Demand Heatmap: DayOfWeek x HourOfDay traffic+outcome analysis

plan.summary: RI-3.2 Demand Heatmap: DayOfWeek(0-6) x HourOfDay(0-23) matris. Tum tarihsel veriyi aggregate eder. Her hucrede total_conversations, sale_count, conversion_rate, avg_response_time_ms. MSSQL'den mesaj timestampleri cekilir, PG wa_demand_heatmap tablosuna yazilir. POST compute + GET read pattern (Paket 1-3 ile ayni).
plan.q_intent: RI-3.2 Demand Heatmap — saat/gun bazli talep yogunlugu analizi, 7x24 matris + outcome korelasyonu
plan.interview_notes: Q confirmed: DayOfWeek x Hour aggregate (not last 7 days), per-cell outcome rates (total, sale, conversion, avg_response_time), wa_demand_heatmap table with UNIQUE(tenant_id, instance_id, day_of_week, hour_of_day)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: POST /api/ops/insights/compute/demand-heatmap endpointi EbruModa icin 168 hucre (7x24) uretir ve wa_demand_heatmap tablosuna yazar
GET /api/ops/insights/demand-heatmap/{tenantId} endpointi hucreleri doner (opsiyonel instanceId filter)
Her hucrede total_conversations, sale_count, conversion_rate, avg_response_time_ms mevcut

verification_questions.question: Does the MSSQL query correctly extract DayOfWeek and HourOfDay from message timestamps for customer messages only?
Is the PG upsert ON CONFLICT correct for the composite key (tenant_id, instance_id, day_of_week, hour_of_day)?
Does the compute handle multi-instance dedup and NULL instanceId correctly?

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: All MSSQL batch errors are logged, error count returned in result. Empty data returns 404.
